name: Joiin
summary: Financial consolidation and group reporting for multi-entity, multi-currency organisations — connects Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, FreeAgent, Zoho Books, Fortnox, MYOB, Pennylane and Puzzle, with unlimited users and reports on every plan; since October 2026 sold as Core, Pro and Max, with multi-currency and forecasting from Pro. Forecasting gives linked P&L, balance sheet and cash flow up to 60 months out, with an AI assistant that drafts the assumptions. Integration list read on joiin.co/integrations, 15 Sep 2026.
best_for: finance teams and accountants consolidating multi-entity, multi-currency group reporting from Xero, QuickBooks or Sage without hand-built spreadsheets
skip_if: you run a single entity (your accounting platform's own reports cover it), or your ledgers live outside the supported integrations and you'd be importing spreadsheets anyway
honest_knock: The headline now hides a three-way split. One company starts at $28 a month on annual billing for Core, but Core reports in a single currency; multi-currency and forecasting start on Pro ($34), and Max, the all-features plan the trial runs on, is $45. A group of 10-20 entities lands at $97-168 a month depending on plan. And it consolidates only what its integrations reach (Xero, QuickBooks, Intuit Enterprise Suite, Sage, MYOB, FreeAgent, Puzzle, Pennylane, Zoho Books and Fortnox), so anything outside that list arrives as a spreadsheet import you repeat every month.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month for one company on Core, billed annually ($35 monthly)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-24 in a browser render of joiin.co/pricing in US dollars at 1, 2, 10 and 100 companies on both billing periods, unchanged; the 5, 20 and 50 company steps and the above-100 fees were last read on 2026-10-06 in the calculator and the price table in its own pricing script) Joiin now sells three plans, Core, Pro and Max, each priced by the number of companies you consolidate. Billed annually, per month: 1 company $28 / $34 / $45, 2 companies $32 / $36 / $47, 5 companies $62 / $66 / $77, 10 companies $97 / $104 / $115, 20 companies $147 / $155 / $168, 50 companies $179 / $189 / $202 and 100 companies $280 / $297 / $325. Billed monthly: $35 / $42 / $49 for one company, $122 / $130 / $144 for ten and $350 / $371 / $406 for a hundred. Above 100 companies you pay the 100-company price plus, for each extra company, $3 / $4 / $5 a month on monthly billing or $28 / $35 / $49 a year on annual billing. Users, reports and clients are unlimited on every plan. Core reports in one currency; Pro adds multi-currency, forecasting, the Excel Add-In, Stripe and non-financial data and AI agents; Max adds report-pack and dashboard templates, custom FX rates, API and Zapier access and the MCP connector. The 14-day trial runs on Max and needs no card. The toggle labels annual billing '2 months free'; at most steps the saving works out at about 20%, but at one company on Max it is $540 a year against $588, about one month. The served HTML and joiin.co/pricing.md still carried the old single table ($23 a month for one company, billed annually) on 6 October 2026; the calculator a visitor sees shows the three plans.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 24 October 2026 on the 14-day trial: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We created two made-up companies in euros, uploaded an October trial balance, exported the consolidated trial balance and opened the checkout without paying.
findings: After sign-up Joiin asked two setup questions (About you, Business details) with the Netherlands prefilled; no card, call or integration was required. The app showed 'Your free trial ends in 14 days'.

We created both companies by hand in EUR and uploaded a trial balance CSV for October. The upload rejected the account type 'Asset'; it went through after we changed it to 'Cash & Equivalent', with revenue as a negative amount.

Financials > Trial Balance for both companies in euros exported to Excel: cash debit and revenue credit each EUR 36.30, a difference of EUR 0.00, with both Unicode company names intact. The file holds consolidated totals with SUM formulas, not per-company amounts, IDs or account codes.
With Annual preselected, the two-company Core plan showed EUR 30 a month, EUR 360 billed annually and EUR 360 due today; the Stripe card page showed no amount or VAT. We stopped there.
The Cancel Trial route says it immediately deletes the account and its data, so ending the trial early means deleting the account. We did not click it.
We found no route to invite a colleague under Account, Your Profile or Plan & Billing.
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
